articles.author: TREASURE GLOBAL INC
articles.headline: Treasure Global Signs MOU to Expand Medical Supply and Pharmaceutical Distribution Across Southeast Asia
articles.summary: Treasure Global announces a nonbinding MOU with Union Concept Trading for medical and pharmaceutical distribution across Malaysia and regional markets, including six months of exclusivity. Commercial terms require definitive agreements; the release does not establish booked procurement revenue.
